My travels / Japan

Our first Japan trip · about a month

Japan
for first-timers

Tokyo neighbourhoods, Kyoto temples, Osaka outings and a weekend in Takayama.

Our route: Tokyo → Kyoto → Osaka → Takayama → Tokyo. We spent around two weeks in Tokyo overall, 10 days in Kyoto, 5–6 days in Osaka and a weekend in Takayama.

These are the outings and ideas from my planning notes, with our booked experiences marked separately. Pick what appeals to you; not every idea was necessarily part of our trip.

A detour from Tokyo

Mount Fuji

Seeing Mount Fuji was beautiful, but honestly the area felt super touristy. I’d spend as little time around the busiest spots as possible, or stay in Fujikawaguchiko and give yourself time to explore beyond the crowds.

More ideas from the plan

Kamakura and Nikko were additional day-trip ideas. Mochi making, sushi making, sumo, a geisha performance, calligraphy and a tea ceremony also appeared in the original wishlist.

My notes also mention Tabelog for restaurant research and collecting goshuin at temples and shrines.
